Absolute paths of the original workstation remain in provenance records that are sealed, hash-referenced or part of the scientific record: backend/asset_migration.json, backend/assets/subset_manifest.json, backend/release_evidence/subset_manifest.json, backend/assets/golden/environment.json, backend/assets/golden/effective_reference_configuration.json, backend/assets/golden/recorded_decision_subset_manifest.json, backend/docs/MASTER_SYSTEM_REPORT.md, backend/docs/CODE_ARCHITECTURE_REFERENCE.md, frontend/docs/reference/MASTER_SYSTEM_REPORT.md, frontend/docs/reference/CODE_ARCHITECTURE_REFERENCE.md, backend/tools/copy_assets.py. They are historical provenance, not configuration; editing them would break SHA-256 seals or the reference-snapshot hashes.

backend/tools/copy_assets.py (ledger-sealed) hard-codes the historical R1 source location. It is the archival asset-migration tool; the migrated assets are included, so it is not needed to run or test the system.
